metadata.title: Fundamental group and $Q$-curvature on open four-manifolds
metadata.abstract: Let $(M,g)$ be a complete, connected, and non-compact four-manifold with nonnegative scalar curvature and nonnegative $Q$-curvature. If $g$ is not Ricci-flat, we show that both the fundamental group $\pi_1(M)$ and the integral of $Q$-curvature are finite, satisfying $$|\pi_1(M)|\int_MQ_g d\mu_g\leq 8\pi^2$$ with the equality holding if and only if $(M,g)$ is isometric to $(\mathbb{R}^4, e^{2u}|\mathrm{d}x|^2)$ with vanishing isoperimetric ratio.
